părangărĭus , a, um, adj., = παράἀγγαρεία,
I.that is done besides the service to which one is bound: praestatio, Cod. Just, 1, 3, 2.—
II. Subst.: părangărĭa , ae, f., a service over and above that which one is bound to render, extra service, Cod. Just. 12, tit. 51; Cod. Th. 8, tit. 5.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
